materials.name: Steel
materials.description: Structural steel: deck plating, ladders and the bulkheads between compartments. Heavy, tough and everywhere.

materials.name: Aluminium Alloy
materials.description: Light aluminium alloy, used for doors and fittings. Soft, and quick to cut.

materials.name: Nanocarbon Alloy
materials.description: The outer hull: layered carbon lattice bonded into a metal matrix. Built to take micrometeorites and reentry heat. Nothing aboard is likely to cut it.
